name: vku-student-survey-app
description: Cross-Platform Mobile App for VKU Student Survey (Capacitor, Android Studio, iOS IPA, Capgo)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap open ios
scripts.capgo:bundle: npm run build && npx @capgo/cli bundle zip --path www
